Today’s kitchen: Rice with creamy chicken - My comfort food!🥰 | 💛 RICE ▫️40 ml olive oil ▫️3 spring onions ▫️1 chicken bouillon cube ▫️0.5 red bell pepper ▫️3 gr paprika powder ▫️3 gr black pepper ▫️3 gr garlic powder ▫️70 gr tomato puree ▫️250 gr rice ▫️550 ml water CHICKEN ▫️5 chicken thighs ▫️5 gr paprika powder ▫️4 gr salt ▫️5 gr garlic powder ▫️3 gr black pepper ▫️15 ml olive oil ▫️25 gr butter (unsalted) SAUCE ▫️200 gr spinach ▫️300 gr strained tomato sauce ▫️60 gr red pesto ▫️250 gr heavy cream ▫️half of a chicken bouillon cube GARNISH ▫️grated cheese ▫️mozzarella Chop the spring onions into pieces. Cut the red bell pepper into cubes. Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the spring onions, red bell pepper and crumble the chicken bouillon cube over the pan. Cook for 3 minutes. Add the paprika powder, black pepper, garlic powder, and tomato puree. Mix well. Add the rice and cook for 1 minute. Add the boiling water and bring to a boil. Once it is boiling well, lower the heat. Cover and cook for 10-12 minutes or until the rice has absorbed all the water. Place the chicken thighs in a deep bowl. Add the paprika powder, salt, garlic powder, black pepper, and olive oil. Mix well. Heat the butter in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken thighs and cook for 6 minutes or until golden brown on both sides. Remove the chicken from the pan. In the same pan, add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add the strained tomato sauce, red pesto, heavy cream, and half a bouillon cube. Cook for 3-4 minutes. Add the chicken thighs and cook for 2 minutes. Divide the rice between an oven-safe dish and place the chicken on top. Cover the dish with the sauce, mozzarella, and grated cheese. Place the dish in a preheated oven at 250℃ for 10-12 minutes or until the cheese is melted and golden brown. Tips: * Let the rice and chicken cool down before serving. * Add vegetables as desired. * Add salt and pepper to taste. Good luck and enjoy! Today’s kitchen: Naan stuffed with cheese and chicken - double so good!🥰 | 💛 DOUGH ▫️125 ml warm water ▫️7 gr instant yeast (1 TBSP) ▫️8 gr granulated sugar (2 TSP) ▫️50 gr yogurt ▫️30 ml sunflower oil 2 (TBSP) ▫️300 gr flour (2 ½ CUPS) ▫️4 gr salt (⅔ tsp) FILLING ▫️300 gr cheese (of your choice) CHICKEN MIXTURE ▫️625 gr chicken breast ▫️4 gr garlic powder (1⅓ TSP) ▫️4 gr onion powder (1⅓ TSP) ▫️2 gr coriander powder (⅔ TSP) ▫️1 gr dried parsley ▫️2 gr cayenne pepper (⅔ TSP) ▫️3 gr cumin powder (1 TSP) ▫️2 gr black pepper (⅔ TSP) ▫️25 ml olive oil (1⅔ TBSP) ▫️25 gr unsalted butter (2 TBSP) ▫️5 gr garam masala (1⅔ TSP) ▫️1 bay leaf ▫️1 chicken stock cube  ▫️100 ml strained tomato sauce ▫️100 ml water ▫️125 ml whipped cream ▫️20 gr honey (1 TBSP) Mix lukewarm water with yeast and sugar in a deep bowl. Mix well. Add yogurt and sunflower oil. Mix until well combined. Add flour and salt. Mix and knead for 10 minutes. Cover dough and let rise for 1 hour in a warm place or until doubled in size. Divide dough into 8 balls (62 grams each) and shape them into nice rounds. Take a ball and flatten it. Place some cheese on top (40 grams each), leaving the sides empty. Fold the dough well closed. Take a rolling pin and flatten the filled ball with cheese. Repeat the process. Bake the rolls in a frying pan on medium-low heat until both sides are cooked. Cover with a clean towel to keep them soft. Wash and cut chicken breast into pieces. Add garlic powder, onion powder, cilantro powder, dried parsley, cayenne pepper, cumin powder, and black pepper. Mix well. Heat olive oil and butter in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook for 3 minutes. Add garam masala and bay leaf, and crumble chicken bouillon cube over the pan. Add strained tomato sauce and water. Cook, covered, for 10-15 minutes. Finally, add the unwhipped cream and honey. Cook until the sauce thickens (remove the lid). Tips: * Add salt and pepper to taste. * Replace chicken breast with chicken thighs. Good luck and enjoy! Today’s kitchen: Sweet honey chickenwraps - this will drive you crazy!🥰 | 💛 CHICKEN MIXTURE ▫️475 gr chicken breast ▫️200 ml buttermilk ▫️1 egg (medium) ▫️6 gr salt (1 tsp) ▫️4 gr garlic powder (1 1/3 tsp) ▫️4 gr onion powder (1 1/3 tsp) ▫️2 gr cayenne pepper (2/3 tsp) ▫️1.5 gr black pepper (1/2 tsp) ▫️0.5 gr dried parsley (1 tsp) FLOUR MIXTURE ▫️125 gr flour (1 cup) ▫️75 gr cornstarch (1/2 cup) ▫️3 gr garlic powder (1 tsp) ▫️3 gr onion powder (1 tsp) ▫️2 gr salt (1/3 tsp) ▫️4 gr powdered sugar (1 tbsp) ▫️2 gr cayenne pepper powder (2/3 tsp) STICKY SAUCE ▫️100 gr honey (3 tbsp) ▫️75 gr chili sauce (3 tbsp) ▫️50 gr unsalted butter (3 tbsp) ▫️10 gr soy sauce (1/2 tbsp) Wash and cut the chicken fillet into pieces. Today’s kitchen: Mini pecan caramel cheesecakes - Packed with flavor | 🤎 PECAN NUT TOPPING ▫️75 gr pecan nuts ▫️50 gr brown caster sugar ▫️1 egg white (medium) COOKIE CRUST ▫️75 gr tea biscuits ▫️75 gr unsalted butter CHEESECAKE BATTER ▫️400 gr cream cheese ▫️50 gr sour cream ▫️75 gr white caster sugar ▫️8 gr vanilla sugar (1 packet) ▫️pinch of salt ▫️30 gr cornstarch ▫️2 eggs (medium) PECAN CARAMEL TOPPING ▫️40 ml water ▫️80 gr granulated sugar ▫️100 ml heavy cream ▫️40 gr unsalted butter ▫️75 gr pecan nuts Grind the pecan nuts (75 gr), brown caster sugar and egg white in a food processor. Mix until fine. Place mixture in a pastry bag and set aside. Melt the butter and grind the tea biscuits finely. Place the ground tea biscuits in a deep bowl and add the butter. Mix well. Take a silicone baking mold. Fill it with cookie dough (14 gr per cheesecake). Press it flat with a glass. This way you prevent the cookie dough from sticking and press everything firmly. Repeat the process. Add the cream cheese and sour cream to a deep bowl. Mix for a minute.  Add the white caster sugar, vanilla sugar, salt and cornstarch. Mix together for a minute. Put the mixer away and use a spatula from now on. Loosen the eggs one by one with the spatula (do not use a mixer, as you will beat the batter). Back to the silicone mold. Fill it with a layer of cheesecake batter over the cookie dough (15 grams) and pipe in the center some pecan nut topping (12 grams). Finish it with another layer of cheesecake batter (35 grams). Place the mini cheesecakes in a preheated oven at 115 ℃ for about 22 to 25 minutes. Turn off the oven and let the cheesecakes cool down slowly in the oven.  PECAN CARAMEL TOPPING Do not chop the pecan nuts (75 gr) too small. Bring the water together with the sugar to a boil over medium heat in a pan for 5 minutes. When the sugar is fully dissolved, increase the heat. Cook for 5 minutes or until the sugar/water mixture turns brown. Turn off the heat. Now, while stirring, add the heavy cream and butter. Mix until well combined. Add the pecan nuts and let it stand until the caramel thickens. Today’s kitchen: Lotus Biscoff cheesecake - Do you love cheesecake? Make this one! | 😍 COOKIE DOUGH ▫️175 gr biscoff cookies ▫️90 gr unsalted butter CHEESECAKE BATTER ▫️600 gr cream cheese ▫️250 gr mascarpone ▫️140 gr granulated sugar ▫️8 gr vanilla sugar ▫️35 gr cornstarch ▫️3 eggs (m) TOPPING ▫️125 gr bisoff spread GARNISH ▫️whipped cream ▫️biscoff cookies ▫️biscoff spread Grind the biscoff cookies in a food processor. Melt the unsalted butter in a saucepan over low heat. Place the ground biscoff cookies in a deep bowl and add the melted butter. Mix until well combined. Distribute the cookie dough over the baking dish and press it firmly against the bottom (use the back of a spoon as a tool). Place the cookie dough in a preheated oven at 175℃. Bake for 15 minutes. Place the cream cheese, mascarpone, sugar, and vanilla sugar in a deep bowl. Mix for 1 minute. Sift the cornstarch over the bowl. Mix for 1 minute. Put the mixer aside and use a spatula from now on. Crack the eggs one by one over the bowl. Stir the egg lightly into the cheesecake batter. Grease the baking dish well and place a piece of baking paper in it. Add the cheesecake batter. Place the biscoff cheesecake in a preheated oven at 125 ℃. Bake for 60 minutes or until the sides are firm and the center still wobbles. Turn off the oven and let the cheesecake sit in the oven for 1 hour. This prevents the cheesecake from collapsing/tearing. Remove the biscoff cheesecake from the oven and place it, covered, in the refrigerator. Preferably overnight. Melt the biscoff spread, stirring, in a saucepan over low heat. Pour the melted biscoff spread over the cheesecake and place, covered, in the refrigerator for 30-45 minutes or until the biscoff spread is firm. Finally, pipe whipped cream on top of the cheesecake. Today’s kitchen: No bake trilece cake | This is so good and easy 💛 CREAM ▫️250 gr mascarpone (or preferred cream cheese) ▫️20 gr sugar ▫️8 gr vanilla sugar ▫️16 gr whipping powder ▫️250 ml heavy cream FILLING ▫️16 ladyfingers ▫️250 ml milk CARAMEL ▫️50 ml water ▫️125 gr sugar ▫️150 ml heavy cream ▫️50 gr unsalted butter GANACHE ▫️20 ml heavy cream ▫️50 gr white chocolate Mix together the mascarpone, sugar, vanilla sugar, and whipping powder in a deep bowl. Heat the heavy cream in a saucepan until just boiling. Add the white chocolate and let it sit for 1 minute. Stir until a smooth mixture forms. Place the white chocolate ganache into a piping bag or a sandwich bag. Pour the caramel mixture over the no-bake trilece cake. Pipe lines of white chocolate ganache on top. Today’s kitchen: Red velvet brownie cheesecakes | a rich, red and fudgy brownie!❤️ RED VELVET BROWNIE BATTER ▫️100 gr unsalted butter ▫️130 gr sugar ▫️8 gr vanilla sugar (1 packet) ▫️6 gr red food coloring gel ▫️1 large egg ▫️125 gr flour (all-purpose flour) ▫️5 gr cocoa powder ▫️100 gr white chocolate CHEESECAKE BATTER ▫️250 gr mascarpone ▫️150 gr cream cheese ▫️75 gr granulated sugar ▫️8 gr vanilla sugar (1 packet) ▫️25 gr cornstarch ▫️1 large egg TOPPING ▫️100 g cream cheese ▫️25 g granulated sugar ▫️8 g whipped cream stabilizer ▫️250 ml heavy cream GARNISH ▫️red velvet crumbs ▫️strawberries Melt the butter in a saucepan over low heat. Let cool. Chop the white chocolate into small pieces. Combine the melted butter, sugar, and vanilla sugar in a large bowl. Mix well. Add the red food coloring gel and mix until combined. Crack the egg into the bowl. Mix well. Sift the flour, baking powder, and cocoa powder into the bowl. Mix well. Add the white chocolate pieces and gently stir to combine. Fill the baking pan with the red velvet brownie batter. Bake the red velvet brownies in a preheated oven at 175℃ for 12-15 minutes. Carefully remove the baking pan from the oven and let cool. Set the oven to 125℃. Combine the mascarpone, cream cheese, sugar, and vanilla sugar in a large bowl. Mix for 1 minute. Sift the cornstarch over the bowl and mix well. Set aside the mixer. Today’s kitchen: Mini msmen with cheese | An easy to follow recipe for msmen 😍 DOUGH ▫️300 gr flour (all-purpose flour) ▫️3 gr salt (1/2 tsp) ▫️160 ml lukewarm water ▫️25 gr unsalted butter FILLING ▫️150 gr grated mozzarella cheese ▫️150 gr Gouda cheese ▫️150 gr la vache qui rit (or other spreadable cheese) EXTRA ▫️herb butter In a deep bowl, combine the flour, salt, water, and butter. Mix well and knead for 10 minutes. Cover the dough and let it rest for 20-30 minutes. Divide the dough into 9 equal portions (53 gr per portion). Grease your work surface with 20 ml of sunflower oil. Take a piece of dough and coat it well with the oil. Repeat the process. Flatten the dough balls and cover with a sheet of plastic wrap. Let it rest for 30-45 minutes. In a bowl, combine the grated mozzarella, grated cheese, and la vache qui rit. Mix until well combined. Divide the cheese mixture into 9 portions and flatten each portion. Grease your work surface again with (10 ml of sunflower oil per msmen). Flatten the dough completely and make a large, thin sheet (35x30cm). Spread the cheese mixture over the dough. Use a pizza cutter to make 4 cuts in the dough (this makes folding much easier). The dough should now be in three parts. Fold the dough per part until it forms a package. Grease a thick-bottomed frying pan well with sunflower oil. PEANUT(BUTTER) BAKLAVA #baklava #baklavarecipe #recipe #ramadan #ramadan2023 #eid #trending #viral #peanuts #peanutbutter #foryou #foryoupage #fy #fyp Baklava is a very popular dish that is loved in many cultures. We thought it would be fun to add our own twist to it. Since we're real peanut freaks at home, we decided to add an extra ingredient: peanut butter. We opted for Calvé Creamy peanut butter. This makes the baklava, which is naturally crispy and sweet, nice and creamy. Definitely worth a try! BUTTER MIXTURE 175 g unsalted butter 50 ml sunflower oil FILLING 400 g unsalted peanuts 175 g Calvé creamy peanut butter 40 g powdered sugar 2 g cinnamon powder (⅔ teaspoon) ENCLOSURE filo pastry GARNISH peanuts EXTRA 300 g honey   Melt the unsalted butter in a saucepan over low heat. Add the sunflower oil and mix well. Pour the butter mixture through a sieve. This will give it a nice shine.   Put the peanuts in a food processor and grind them to a fine, but not too coarse consistency. Place the peanuts in a bowl. Add the Calvé Creamy Peanut Butter, powdered sugar, and cinnamon powder. Mix until well combined.   Take the filo pastry and cut it to the size of your baking dish. This way you can easily and neatly stack them.   Take a baking dish and cover the bottom with a sheet of filo pastry. Brush it well with the butter mixture. Repeat this step 10 times.   Spread the peanut mixture over it and press it down firmly. Take the remaining sheets of filo pastry and stack them on top of each other with the butter mixture in between (again, 10 layers).   Cut the baklava into small squares. Pour the remaining butter mixture over it. Garnish each square with a (half) peanut, pressing it in well.   Place the peanut baklava in a preheated oven at 190 ℃. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until it is nicely golden brown. Keep an eye on the baking time because every oven works differently. Warm the honey in a saucepan over low heat. Pour the warm honey over the warm peanut baklava.   created by Kookmutsjes with Megan Yagami’s Ramadan Kareem
